test.title: Something you bought that you were disappointed with

document.cue: Describe something you bought that you were disappointed with.

text: I'd like to talk about a pair of wireless headphones I bought online about a year ago. They were from a brand I'd never heard of, and they were on sale for about half the price of the well-known models, which should probably have been a warning sign.

I ordered them from a big marketplace app late one evening, after watching a video review that described them as 'the best budget headphones of the year'. The photos looked great, they had noise cancellation and a battery that supposedly lasted forty hours, so I didn't think twice.

When they arrived, they looked fine, but the problems started within a week. The right earphone kept disconnecting, the noise cancellation made a strange hissing sound, and the battery lasted about eight hours, not forty. I tried to return them, but the seller stopped replying, and in the end I had to open a dispute with the marketplace, which took almost a month.

I was disappointed not only because of the money, but because I'd ignored all my own rules. I bought them on impulse, trusted a single review and didn't check the seller's rating. Eventually I got a refund, but I also learned an expensive lesson.
These days I'd rather pay more and buy something I can actually rely on.
